In the foreground, stylized cloud cutouts are positioned at the bottom left and right, with layered blue waves occupying the lower portion of the frame. Four women are partially submerged in these waves in the bottom-left and center foreground, performing synchronized arm movements by first reaching toward the ship and then raising their arms upward. The camera remains static and is positioned at the level of the subjects on the ship.
